benchmark.name: RoboBench

summary.en: RoboBench evaluates multimodal models on embodied-robotics reasoning across perception, planning, and interaction tasks.
summary.zh: RoboBench 评估多模态模型在 embodied robotics 中完成 perception、planning 和 interaction task 的能力。

task_format.en: The model receives visual and task context for robotics scenarios and answers under the benchmark's multimodal reasoning protocol.
task_format.zh: 模型会收到 robotics 场景中的视觉和 task context，并按照 benchmark 的 multimodal reasoning protocol 作答。

explanation.en: This card uses only the official Perception Reasoning average. Planning, affordance, and other RoboBench dimensions are separate measurement objects.
explanation.zh: 本卡只使用官方 Perception Reasoning average。Planning、affordance 和 RoboBench 的其他 dimension 属于独立 measurement object。

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
